bullets: **Tech Stack:** Develop and maintain a cloud-based localization platform; delivered new security and privacy requirements via Java backend services and CI quality gates (**Jenkins, SonarQube, Kubernetes**).

**Responsibility:** Re-architected the existing **LLM** solution into a new agent framework (**RAG + function calling**) to accurately retrieve user-requested rows across 30+ interrelated tables and hundreds of columns, improving retrieval precision and latency.
**Achievement:** Added support for previously unsupported long, OR-heavy, and highly complex filter conditions, enabling more expressive translation workflow queries.

**Tech Stack & Responsibility:** **Fine-tuned and deployed LLMs** for NLP-based customer service solutions in retail. Implemented **RESTful APIs** for model inference, integrating directly with client applications. Worked with large-scale structured and unstructured data, performing **feature engineering** and **embeddings** to enhance NLP model understanding.

**Delivered:** An end-to-end **AI chatbot platform**, integrating with multiple **social media channels** and a **web-based admin console** for configuration, monitoring, and conversation management, with the system **directly connected to production servers** for real-time inference and deployment.

**Tech Stack:** Designed system architecture and managed a small team to drive progress and meet deadlines. Developed the frontend using **React**, integrated a **Python Flask** backend with MongoDB. Containerized and deployed the system using **Docker**; integrated **OpenAI APIs** for intelligent text analysis.
**Responsibility:** Revived and led the successful delivery of a long-stalled university curriculum tracking project.

**Outcome:** **Built and shipped** a curriculum analytics dashboard that programmatically extracts and structures degree requirements from university websites using **LLMs**, enabling cross-year and cross-program comparisons, now in internal use by the **UBC Provost Office**.
**Responsibility:** Managed the entire research project, from creatively solving the problem to delivering the application to customers.

**Tech Stack & Achievement:** Developed a **deep learning model** using distinct **CNN** architectures for the differentiation of tumour types in chest tumor CT scans, achieving an accuracy rate exceeding 96%.
